name: Spatial Selectivity
definition: A property allowing reconstruction of a specific subregion $[i_1, j_1] \times [i_2, j_2] \times [i_3, j_3]$ by selecting specific rows from the factor matrices $U^{(1)}, U^{(2)}, U^{(3)}$.
summary: Spatial Selectivity reconstructs specific subvolumes by selecting factor matrix rows, enabling efficient access to restricted data without full volume reconstruction.
